================================================================================
SYNTHETIC DEMO NOTICE A — SCHOLARSHIP ANNOUNCEMENT (WITH AMBIGUOUS DEADLINE)
================================================================================
GOVERNMENT OF SYNTHETIC STATE
DIRECTORATE OF HIGHER EDUCATION & STUDENT WELFARE
Sachivalaya Complex, Sector 4, Gandhinagar - 382010

Notification Ref: SCHOLARSHIP/POST-MATRIC/2026/SYN-884
Date of Notification: 15 October 2026

SUBJECT: POST-MATRIC MERIT-CUM-MEANS SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME (ACADEMIC YEAR 2026-2027)

1. OBJECTIVE & SCHOLARSHIP BENEFIT:
The Directorate announces scholarship assistance of Rs. 45,000 per academic year for meritorious students pursuing full-time undergraduate degree courses in recognized institutions.

2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
- Candidate must be a bona fide resident and domicile of the State.
- Minimum 75% aggregate marks in the Senior Secondary (Class 12) Examination.
- Total family annual gross income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 3,50,000.
- Student must not be a recipient of any other central or state government scholarship.

3. MANDATORY DOCUMENTS REQUIRED:
i. Domicile / Permanent Residence Certificate issued by competent Revenue Officer.
ii. Income Certificate for Financial Year 2025-2026.
iii. Class 10 and Class 12 Marks Cards (self-attested).
iv. Active Student Bank Account Passbook copy (linked with Aadhaar).
v. College Admission Fee Receipt and Bonafide Certificate from the Principal.

4. APPLICATION DEADLINE & PROCEDURE (AMBIGUOUS / TENTATIVE):
Applications must be submitted online through the State Student Welfare Portal at www.scholarship.synthetic-state.example.gov.in.
NOTE ON DEADLINE: The closing date for online student registration is tentatively scheduled for 15 November 2026; however, this date is provisional and subject to technical portal extension by the state IT committee. Students are advised to apply tentatively by mid-November.

5. OFFICIAL CONTACT & GRIEVANCE HELPDESK:
State Scholarship Cell, Directorate of Higher Education
Email: grievance-scholarship@synthetic-gov.example.org
Toll-Free Helpline: 1800-000-0199 (Mon-Fri, 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM)
